caption.en: Sliding-window causal mask for N = 8 and W = 4. Each dot is an allowed (key j, query i) pair; grey dots are the causal pairs that the window removes. 26 of the 36 causal entries remain. Queries go upward, keys to the right.
caption.fr: Masque causal à fenêtre glissante pour N = 8 et W = 4. Chaque point est une paire autorisée (clé j, requête i) ; les points gris sont les paires causales que la fenêtre supprime. 26 des 36 entrées causales subsistent. Requêtes vers le haut, clés vers la droite.

caption.en: Global plus local mask (window W = 4 and key 0 as a global token). Blue: sliding window; orange: the extra global column, so every query reaches position 0 at a cost of about N(W + g) entries; grey: still masked.

caption.en: Differential attention: queries and keys are split in two groups, two softmax maps are computed, the second scaled by lambda is subtracted, and the difference multiplies V. The common-mode noise floor cancels.
